howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.heroSubtitle: LatamTCG lets you order TCG cards from verified international stores and receive them directly at your home in Chile.
howItWorks.intro: LatamTCG lets you order TCG cards from verified international stores and receive them directly at your home in Chile.

step1.title: Step 1: Find your cards
step1.body: Browse the catalog and add the items you want to your cart.

step2.title: Step 2: Pay in CLP
step2.body: You pay in Chilean Pesos, with no hidden fees or extra charges upon delivery.

step3.title: Step 3: We manage the purchase and import
step3.body: We buy from verified sellers, consolidate shipments, and handle the import process safely.

step4.title: Step 4: Receive your cards at home
step4.body: Orders typically arrive within 10–15 business days. We notify you whenever there's an update on your shipment.

howItWorks.closingCta: LatamTCG connects you with the global Magic market, without borders or complications. Thousands of cards, one click, and the peace of mind of getting exactly what you want.

why.title: Why trust LatamTCG?
why.body: If a seller cannot secure your order, we immediately contact you and offer:
why.body2: If your package is delayed, lost, or arrives incomplete, we review the case and resolve it with a refund or replacement.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.body: LatamTCG is an independent project created by TCG players for TCG players. We operate from Providencia, Santiago, Metropolitan Region (Chile).
whoWeAre.body2: We love our local community and want to make international card purchasing simple, affordable, and worry-free.
whoWeAre.contact: For help, contact us at hola@latamtcg.com.

payment.title: Secure payments with Flow
payment.body: All payments are processed through Flow, a trusted Chilean payment provider.
payment.bullet2: We never see or store your card details
payment.closing: Flow handles the entire checkout process.

returns.title: Short return summary
returns.point2: in worse condition than expected, or
returns.body2: just contact us within 3 days of delivery.
returns.body3: We will review your case and help with a refund or replacement.

tracking.question: Do orders have tracking?
tracking.answer: Yes. Every order includes tracking, and we send the code as soon as it ships.

chileanCard.question: Can I pay with a Chilean card?
chileanCard.answer: Yes. All payments are in CLP via Flow.

customs.question: Do I need to pay import taxes upon delivery?
customs.answer: No. The price you see already includes:

newOrUsed.question: Are the cards new or used?
newOrUsed.answer: It depends on the seller. We show each card's condition exactly as provided by verified vendors.

cantSecure.question: What happens if a seller cannot secure the items?
cantSecure.answer: We notify you immediately and issue a full refund or help with replacements.

returns.title: Refund and Return Policy — LatamTCG (Chile, MVP)
returns.summaryPoint1: We accept returns only for: incorrect item, shipping damage, or sealed product defect.
returns.summaryPoint2: Report issues within 48 hours of delivery (sealed defects: within 7 days).
returns.summaryPoint3: Returns are not accepted for change of mind on individual cards.
returns.summaryPoint4: LatamTCG captures a photo at dispatch for each qualified order; we will compare with your evidence.
returns.summaryPoint5: Refunds are issued after verification (and, if necessary, after inspecting the returned item).
returns.eligibilityText: We accept returns/refunds only in these cases:
returns.eligibility1: Incorrect item received (printing/version different from what your order confirms).
returns.eligibility2: Item damaged in transit (visible damage to product/packaging upon arrival).
returns.eligibility3: Defect in sealed product (e.g., altered seal).
returns.eligibilityNote: We do not accept returns for individual cards once opened/handled, except when there is clear proof of shipping damage or incorrect item.
returns.timeframe1: Incorrect item / shipping damage: notify us within 48 hours of delivery.
returns.timeframe2: Sealed product defect: notify us within 7 days of delivery.
returns.timeframeNote: After these periods, we cannot process returns or refunds.
returns.claimStep1: Send an email to {email} within the valid timeframe and include your order number.
returns.claimStep2b: The external packaging and shipping label/dispatch guide
returns.claimStep3: We review within 48 hours. If approved, we will send a Return Authorization (RMA) or immediate resolution steps.
returns.claimStep4: Refunds/replacements are processed through Flow after verification and, when applicable, after inspection of the returned item. Processing time depends on the original payment method (see 'Refund Methods' section).
returns.dispatchEvidence: Dispatch evidence: LatamTCG may capture a photo at dispatch (product + shipping label/dispatch guide). Your claim will be verified against this record.
returns.returnCondition1: Items must be returned in their original condition, unaltered and in their packaging.
returns.returnCondition2: Returns must be authorized in advance with an RMA.
returns.denyReason1: There are signs of use/handling after delivery.
returns.denyReason2: The received item does not match what we sent.
returns.denyReason3: Evidence is insufficient or inconsistent with our dispatch records.
returns.shippingCost1: LatamTCG error / shipping damage / sealed defect: we cover return shipping.
returns.shippingCost2: Unauthorized or ineligible returns: customer covers shipping; package may be rejected.
returns.shippingCost3: For high-value orders (threshold defined by LatamTCG), we may require tracked shipping and delivery signature.
returns.fraudPreventionText: To protect our community, all claims are subject to verification. LatamTCG may deny or revoke refunds in cases of suspected fraud, forged returns, or item alteration, and may restrict account access and/or file payment disputes.
returns.refundMethodsText: Refunds are processed through Flow, our payment provider, and issued in CLP using the original payment method:
returns.refundMethod3: The customer has 10 calendar days to accept the refund from notification. If not accepted, the money will be returned in the next settlement.
returns.refundFeeText: Each refund has a cost of $202 + VAT ($240 CLP), which will be deducted from the next settlement and invoiced once the refund has been accepted by the customer.
returns.refundNote: Initial shipping fees are refunded only when the problem is attributable to LatamTCG (incorrect item, shipping damage, sealed defect).
